label: copy-phase input h near end of long sequences
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase, never during the original or delimiter phase. It fires only on repeated (non-first) inputs and mostly on the last one or two copy steps of long sequences (t >= 11, L 6-9; L = 9 holds 62% of the mass). The input token is h about 81% of the time, with e (11%) and 0 (8%) making up most of the rest. Activation rises with t: the rate is about 25x baseline at t = 17. The predicate is close to a necessary condition (72% of activation mass) but far from sufficient: precision is about 6%, because most late copy-phase h inputs do not activate it, and none of the tabulated variables (out_tok, prev_tok, first_tok, L) separates the active cases. It does not fire on h in the original phase, or on h early in the copy phase.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=h (+6.28), phase=2 & in_tok=e (+3.75), phase=2 & in_tok=0 (+3.35), phase=2 & out_tok=j (+2.52), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+2.21), L=9 & t=17 (+2.07). Lower it: recall_idx=2 (-1.94), orig5=- (-1.65), t=10 (-1.51), orig8=- (-1.21).
